conventions.convention: AC is assumed throughout the assigned results and example; the analytic, resolution, duality and injective-resolution suppliers retain their choice assumptions.
Quasiprojective and projective use finite-dimensional projective-space immersion and closed-immersion conventions, respectively.
SNC boundaries are reduced effective Cartier divisors with parameter-coordinate crossings; differing component dimensions are handled separately.
Cap evaluates the front face, retains the back face, and has no additional evaluation sign; complex manifolds use their complex orientation.
Cohomological weights are shifted from complex weights: W_m H^n(K) is the image of H^n(W_{m-n}K). The logarithmic pole filtration has W_0 equal to the ordinary holomorphic de Rham complex.

Q(-a) has weight 2a and type (a,a); a residue of a logarithmic a-fold meridian generator has comparison factor (2πi)^(-a). Normalized rational residue coordinates differ from ordinary analytic residues.

load_bearing.statement: Assume AC. Let U be smooth quasiprojective over C, and choose an SNC smooth projective compactification j:U→X, boundary D. The logarithmic de Rham complex with Hodge filtration by degree and pole-count weight filtration constructs a functorial rational mixed Hodge structure on H^n(U,Q), independent of the compactification. Its weights are at least n, and W_n H^n(U,Q)=im(H^n(X,Q)→H^n(U,Q)).

Assume AC. Every smooth quasiprojective complex variety U admits a smooth projective compactification j:U→X with reduced boundary a simple normal crossings divisor D. Given finitely many such compactifications, there is another dominating all of them and restricting to the identity on U. A morphism of smooth quasiprojective varieties extends to a morphism of such compactifications after modifying the source compactification outside its open variety.

Assume AC. Let p:X′→X be a proper morphism between smooth projective complex varieties of equal pure dimension, restricting to the identity on a common open variety U. Then H^n(X,Q) and H^n(X′,Q) have the same image in H^n(U,Q) for every n. Consequently the compactification-image formula of logarithmic weights extends from an SNC compactification to every smooth projective compactification.

seams_checked.note: The analytic-topology and constructibility definitions are used with their stated conventions. The constant-sheaf comparison is applied to metric manifolds with contractible-open bases. The smooth-cochain adaptation and actual filtered global models are constructed locally in the logarithmic proof rather than asserted by the definitions.

The opened Hodge theorem supplies pure cohomology, the holomorphic-degree image filtration, and Hodge-de Rham E1 degeneration on compact Kähler strata. The logarithmic proof derives differential strictness for its actual resolved complexes and includes zero-dimensional and empty cases.

The logarithmic proof constructs a single weight-filtered comparison map, verifies all graded mixed-Hodge-complex axioms, and uses the supplier's shifted weights, E2 degeneration and induced-Hodge-filtration identification. Its shifts, residues and independence argument also agree with [Deligne, Théorie de Hodge II](https://www.numdam.org/item/PMIHES_1971__40__5_0.pdf), §§3.1.5–3.1.9 and 3.2.3–3.2.17.

The analytification supplier supplies compact Hausdorff second-countable complex manifolds, holomorphic algebraic morphisms, and positive closed (1,1)-forms from ample classes. The assigned proofs use these consequences without importing a stronger relative or singular polarization theorem.

The fixed-part theorem's F3 and Steps 1.1–2.1 use SNC compactification, weights at least the degree, the compactification-image identity, and smooth-open functoriality for the algebraic fibre inclusion. The compact fibre's empty-boundary structure is correctly identified with its pure projective structure.

The proper-weights theorem uses the explicit empty-boundary Godement construction and constructs its smooth-open pullback separately. The restriction-image theorem faithfully uses the image formula for arbitrary smooth projective compactifications, justified by SNC domination and the modification lemma.
